description: E26 line-by-line accounting of the archived unierp-app-realestate repository. Every archived source file is disposed as PORTED (logic carried forward), REWRITTEN (re-expressed against the public extension API), or DROPPED (with a reason). Enforced by scripts/check-e26-port.mjs.

entries.reason: Prisma models re-expressed as declared extension schema entities (ext_real_estate_<entity> with tenant_id+RLS); all money fields (rent, deposit, cost, commission) declared decimal.
Prisma CLI config; the extension has no Prisma data layer.
NestJS bootstrap; the platform is the host for extensions.
Core event fan-out was monolith infrastructure; extension events are a manifest scope, not a local HTTP endpoint.
NestJS controller endpoints re-expressed as customRoutes handlers.
ASC-842 schedule (PV, interest, liability/ROU amortization), classification, portfolio summary, rent roll and expiring leases carried forward as pure functions; money arithmetic rounds to cents.
NestJS HTTP bootstrap; the platform loads extension factories.
Prisma client; extensions have no direct DB handle.
NestJS CRUD controller endpoints re-expressed as customRoutes handlers.
Property/lease/maintenance/commission CRUD logic carried forward as pure functions over in-memory record sets.
Authorization is enforced by the platform via manifest scope grants; the extension cannot self-authorize.
Tenant identity is provided by the platform context (ExtensionContext.tenantId).
